description:
Python Developer in this role, you will work on content-enabled workflow solutions designed specifically for professionals in the legal, risk management, corporate, government, law enforcement, accounting, and academic markets. You will drive innovation to support collections, conversions and parsing of a wide variety of content and working in a distributed environment to enrich the content for supporting world class web applications with strong search capabilities.

 Responsibilities:

 Write and review portions of detailed specifications for the development of system components of moderate complexity
    Work closely with other development team members to understand product requirements and translate them into software designs
    Operate in various development environments (Agile, Waterfall, etc.) while collaborating with key stakeholders
    Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues as necessary
    Keep abreast of new technology development
    All other duties assigned


Job Requirements:

    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or relevant field required
    Experience with Unix and MS Windows
    Basic understanding of SQL and relational databases
    Experience with following programming languages:
    Python – required
    C#
    XPath
    Regular Expressions
    Object oriented technology
    HTML, XHTML, XML
    SQL
    CSS
    JavaScript
    JQuery
    Knowledge of working in AWS environment
    Power shell – would be a plus
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
